source: Online variant (experimental): to be measured by `ale validate`'s oracle pass on the graded episode hidden-1 (tests/online.json): the privileged reference cleaner (tests/house_cell/reference.py, frozen at commit 4549238 by amendment 4; environment/setup/online/house_cell is its byte copy) run inside the graded episode's cell service through the agent-side client (solution/solve.sh), its measured episode_score.
note: cleaning_score of the online variant is one episode's score, already on [0, 1]: the cell's stage score of the graded episode as it ended (the checklist's credit, less the damage charges, over its total weight of 10), 0 with a safety violation, as the offline verifier scores each episode. A scene replays the same numbers (its layout, the crumbs' motion and the noise are drawn from its seed; the service's BLAS is pinned as the offline grader's), so full_at 0.98 only absorbs a last-digit difference between machines. Offline, the same reference scored 0.9167 on this scene (tests/review/hidden_set.md, amendment 4).
